# Kyoto 4-Day Trip Plan: Apr 10–13, 2026

A relaxed Kyoto plan centered on temples, local food, and low-effort transit, with a mid-range stay near Kyoto Station. Budget target is kept close to **$1,800 total for 2 adults**, excluding international flights.

# Day-by-Day Kyoto Itinerary and Cost Plan

## Trip Budget Snapshot
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/currency-dollar.svg

- **Trip length:** 4 days / 3 nights
- **Style:** mid-range, temple-focused, light walking
- **Recommended hotel spend:** about **$120–$180/night**
- **Daily spend target for 2:** about **$300–$380/day** including hotel, food, transport, and entry fees

| Day | Focus | Estimated Hotel | Estimated Food | Estimated Transport | Estimated Activities | Daily Total |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Apr 10 | Central Kyoto + Gion | $150 | $70 | $20 | $35 | $275 |
| Apr 11 | Eastern temples + tea district | $150 | $80 | $25 | $45 | $300 |
| Apr 12 | Arashiyama + western Kyoto | $150 | $80 | $30 | $40 | $300 |
| Apr 13 | Fushimi Inari + departure day | $150 | $60 | $20 | $20 | $250 |

## 4-Day Kyoto Itinerary

### Day 1: Kyoto Station Base + Gion Evening
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg

- **Morning:** Arrive, check in near Kyoto Station, easy lunch around the station area.
- **Afternoon:** Keep it light with **Nishiki Market** and nearby shopping streets.
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/e/e5/A_store_at_Nishiki_market%2C_Kyoto%2C_Japan.jpg Alt=Afternoon:** Keep it light with **Nishiki Market** and nearby shopping streets, Kyoto, Japan
- **Evening:** Walk through **Gion** and **Yasaka Shrine** at a relaxed pace.
- **Food:** Try yuba, tofu dishes, grilled skewers, and matcha sweets.
- **Estimated cost for 2:** Hotel **$150**, food **$70**, transport **$20**, activities **$35**.

### Day 2: Higashiyama Temples and Tea Culture
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/tree.svg

- **Morning:** Visit **Kiyomizu-dera** early for calmer crowds.
- **Afternoon:** Slow walk through **Sannenzaka**, **Ninenzaka**, and **Kodai-ji** area.
- **Evening:** Tea break in **Higashiyama** or a quiet kaiseki-style dinner.
- **Food:** Matcha parfait, soba, seasonal Kyoto vegetables, and a set dinner.
- **Estimated cost for 2:** Hotel **$150**, food **$80**, transport **$25**, activities **$45**.

### Day 3: Arashiyama Scenic Day
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/map.svg

- **Morning:** Go to **Arashiyama Bamboo Grove** and **Tenryu-ji**.
- **Afternoon:** Choose one gentle add-on: **Iwatayama Monkey Park** only if you feel like a short climb, or stay low-key with the river area and shops.
- **Evening:** Return to Kyoto Station for an easy dinner.
- **Food:** Tofu skin dishes, yudofu, croquettes, and dessert cafés.
- **Estimated cost for 2:** Hotel **$150**, food **$80**, transport **$30**, activities **$40**.

### Day 4: Fushimi Inari + Departure
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg

- **Morning:** Visit **Fushimi Inari Taisha** early; do a short out-and-back walk rather than the full summit.
- **Afternoon:** Lunch near Kyoto Station, pick up souvenirs, and depart.
- **Evening:** Keep this flexible for your departure time.
- **Food:** Inari sushi, ramen, and station bento for the road.
- **Estimated cost for 2:** Hotel **$150**, food **$60**, transport **$20**, activities **$20**.

## Mid-Range Hotel Picks Near Kyoto Station

### 1) Daiwa Roynet Hotel Kyoto Ekimae
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/house.svg

- Good fit for a practical mid-range stay with easy station access.
- Best for minimizing transit effort after temple days.
- Typical budget target: **$120–$180/night** for a double room.
- Action: [Button: Check Rates](https://www.booking.com/city/jp/kyoto.html)

### 2) Hotel Keihan Kyoto Ekimae
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg

- Convenient for Kyoto Station, with simple access to buses and trains.
- Strong value if you want to keep the trip comfortably within budget.
- Typical budget target: **$110–$170/night** for a double room.
- Action: [Button: Check Rates](https://www.booking.com/city/jp/kyoto.html)

### 3) Sakura Terrace The Gallery
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/star.svg

- Slightly more design-forward while still staying in the mid-range zone.
- Good if you want a nicer hotel feel without going luxury.
- Typical budget target: **$130–$190/night** for a double room.
- Action: [Button: Check Rates](https://www.booking.com/city/jp/kyoto.html)

## Budget Fit for Your 2-Person Trip

| Category | Estimated Total |
|---|---:|
| Hotel, 3 nights | $450 |
| Food, 4 days | $290 |
| Local transport | $95 |
| Temple entries / activities | $140 |
| Snacks, coffee, misc. | $100 |
| Buffer | $150 |
| **Estimated Trip Total** | **$1,225** |

- This plan leaves room for a nicer dinner, extra shopping, or a better hotel while staying under **$1,800**.
- If you upgrade to a more premium hotel, you still have a comfortable cushion.
- Kyoto is very workable on this budget with the hotel near Kyoto Station.
